dataset.name: legal-contracts
dataset.source: Original synthetic contracts authored for RAG Workbench
dataset.description: Seven short commercial contracts (NDA, master services, SaaS subscription, data processing addendum, reseller, statement of work, software licence) with 48 clause-anchored retrieval queries. Fully synthetic and offline.
notes: All contract text is original and authored for this project; no third-party material is included.
Relevance is judged at the clause/evidence-unit level, never per whole document.
Clause numbering varies per contract (integers, decimals, roman numerals, letters) to exercise clause-boundary chunking.
committed artifact: each query's trace is capped at 5 items; aggregates and per-query metrics are complete
